title: Mission giver asset failure is not mission lifecycle evidence
action: mission giver asset and conversation package fail to load

sensitivityHandling.notes: Mission template and giver identifiers are synthetic and do not represent an accepted player contract.

expectedNonEvents.reason: Loading a mission giver asset does not prove a player-facing offer.
Missing mission-giver data does not prove a previously offered mission was withdrawn.
Asset fallback is a subsystem error, not a local-player mission outcome.

correlation.notes: Mission-giver records can be diagnostic source context only.
